text:
• Cost: local inference drops the marginal cost per user close to zero.
• Privacy: data never leaves the device, which can unblock health and finance apps.
• Battery: continuous transcription cost 12%; batching audio fixed it.
• Size: quantization brings models to 1–2 GB with a small quality loss.
• Hybrid router: easy questions on the device, hard ones in the cloud; 80% stay local.
• Advice: start hybrid, measure, and move work to the device over time.

summary.takeaway: Start hybrid, measure, and move work down to the device over time.
keyPoints: Moving summarization to the phone cut inference cost by 70% and first-token latency from 900 ms to 120 ms.
Data never leaves the device, which unblocked two hospital customers.

tradeoffs.fix: 4-bit quantization to 1.4 GB, under 2% quality loss

tradeoffs.issue: The small model can't answer everything
tradeoffs.fix: Hybrid router: below 0.7 confidence goes to the cloud; 80% stay on device
